Thanks for the note, Lisa — quick answers below and I’ve looped in Monica (AM) and Kimberly (billing) to confirm the invoice flow and produce an adjustment PDF you can attach to your PO.

Short answers:
- We issue a prorated adjustment line item on the same monthly invoice (not a separate full-month charge). The platform calculates a daily rate and charges only for the days the extra capacity was active.
- For EU customers: VAT is applied based on the billing entity and VAT rules. For B2B customers with a valid EU VAT ID and reverse-charge eligibility, we do not apply VAT on the charge — we annotate the invoice accordingly. If Orion needs VAT applied, Kimberly will include it.

Next steps I’m taking now:
1) Kimberly — can you generate a draft adjustment invoice showing the daily proration and VAT treatment (if any)?
2) Monica — I’ve flagged this for expedited billing so Orion can close their month.

Lisa, I’ll send the draft PDF in a follow-up email shortly.
